nodes.name: Sol-gel synthesis of MTi5
nodes.procedure: MTi5 was synthesised by a two-step method consisting firstly of the preparation of a solid precursor through hydrolysis of titanium alkoxide (titanium tetra-isopropoxide) followed by heat treatment at 250°C under ambient air for 1 h. This method led to a highly porous material with 200 nm homogenous particle size. By a simple annealing treatment for 1 h at 250°C well-defined homogeneous crystallites of 8±1 nm diameter can be prepared.

nodes.description: In situ Raman monitored lithium insertion/de-insertion into Prolabo TiO2 anatase

working_electrode.unit: 57 wt% TiO2, 14 wt% carbon black, 29 wt% PVDF

nodes.source_text: For a C/22 rate, the first discharge process of TiO2 anatase (Prolabo) occurs at 1.77 V (±0.01 V), while the first charge is observed at a slightly higher potential of 1.90 V (±0.01 V) (Fig. 6). In reduction a capacity of ca. 0.45 lithium ions per mole of oxide (150 Ah kg−1) is observed at the cut-off potential of 1 V.

nodes.characterization_summary: All samples show anatase phase (S.G. I41/amd) with close lattice parameters: Prolabo a=b=3.7850(6) Å c=9.514(2) Å; AK1 a=b=3.786(1) Å c=9.507(3) Å; MTi5 a=b=3.791(3) Å c=9.479(6) Å; cell volume ~136.3 Å³. AK1 shows broadening characteristic of small crystallites.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Whatever the sample, close lattice parameters with a cell volume of about 136.3 Å³ (Table 1) were found. ... AK1 shows a broadening of the Bragg peaks characteristic of the presence of small crystallites (Fig. 1).

properties.description: Likely a material sample or variant

nodes.characterization_summary: High resolution TEM shows AK1 formed from aggregation of crystallites 10-20 nm diameter and MTi5 has homogeneous crystallites of 8±1 nm diameter.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Textural and micro-textural characterisations of the powders were performed by means of high resolution transmission electron microscopy (TEM) with a FEI TEC-NAI F20 ST microscope.

nodes.characterization_summary: Brunauer–Emmett–Teller surface areas are 10 m²g⁻¹ for Prolabo, 51 m²g⁻¹ for AK1, and 223 m²g⁻¹ for MTi5.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Specific surface areas were evaluated with a Micromeritics Gemini II 2375 analyzer based on the Brunauer–Emmett–Teller (BET) multipoint method from results of N₂ physisorption at 77 K.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ex situ Raman spectra show characteristic anatase bands: Eg 143/144/145 cm⁻¹ (FWHM 8/12/16 cm⁻¹), Eg 195 cm⁻¹, B1g 393/393/396 cm⁻¹, A1g+B1g 514/515/515 cm⁻¹, Eg 636/638/639 cm⁻¹ for Prolabo/AK1/MTi5 respectively, with broadening for smaller particles.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The spectrum of the Prolabo TiO₂ sample therefore presents these five bands (Table 2 for assignment of the bands)... Comparing the band positions measured in this investigation to previous works...
